name: ai-personal
description: Personal library of reusable Claude Code skills and orchestration suites.

plugins.name: atomic-commits
plugins.description: Generate clean, atomic git commits from working changes with meaningful messages that explain why, not just what.

plugins.name: create-adr
plugins.description: Create a new Architecture Decision Record (ADR) in docs/adrs/

plugins.name: create-changelog
plugins.description: Create or append a dated entry to a skill's CHANGELOG.md

plugins.name: fix-validation
plugins.description: Run scripts/validate.sh, auto-fix mechanical structural issues, and report what needs manual authorship

plugins.name: readme-maintenance
plugins.description: Audit and refresh every README in the repo against a quality rubric, one reviewer subagent per workspace

plugins.name: yaml-frontmatter
plugins.description: Validate, add, or update YAML frontmatter on documentation files

plugins.name: handoff-workflow
plugins.description: Multi-session work loop: handoff.md carries state between sessions via resume-handoff/handoff-document, then ingest-handoff retires completed work into ADRs, docs/memory, and the handoff archive.

plugins.name: hub-and-spoke-orchestration
plugins.description: Multi-agent software-engineering pipeline: a central Orchestrator dispatches Planner/Explorer/Coder/Reviewer/Arbiter/Executor spokes and a Scribe write-path service against one shared protocol.

plugins.name: tiered-team-orchestration
plugins.description: A three-tier model-cost hierarchy — an Opus-tier core orchestrator plans and routes, Sonnet-tier research/coding/review team leads decompose and synthesize, Haiku-tier workers execute narrow tasks.

plugins.name: tier-layered-teams
plugins.description: A two-axis orchestration lattice crossing model-cost team tiers (Opus orchestrator, Sonnet leads, Haiku workers) with T0-T3 tool escalation — Claude Code-native variant.
